title: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in Realty Income, Comcast and Hormel Pays $79,746 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across Realty Income, Comcast and Hormel Foods pays about $79,700 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $6,650 a month. Realty Income and Comcast cover their dividends comfortably, at 75% of AFFO and 24% of free cash flow.
